spans.s:
hiraṇya (IE 8-5; EI 12, 28, 29), same as hiraṇy-āya, hiraṇya-deya; tax payable to the king in cash; dues payable in coins; cash; sometimes abbreviated as hi as in sāṃ-hi=sāṃvatsarika-hiraṇya, annual revenue income in cash; cf. a-hiraṇya-dhānya-praṇaya-pradeya (IE 8-5); it may be in addition to the tax in grain or in lieu of the latter. Cf. Tamil kāś-āya, etc. Also cf. suvarṇ-ādāya, svarṇ-āya. []
 (HRS), king's share of certain crops paid in cash.
 (CII 1), probably, ‘money’.
hiraṇyagarbha (EI 16; IA 10; SII 3), name of a mahādāna.
Hiraṇyakāra (LL), a treasurer; also a goldsmith or mint-master. Cf. Hairaṇyika.
Hiraṇyasāmudāyika (IE 8-3), a collector of revenue in cash; sometimes mentioned along with the Audraṅgika or the collector of the udraṅga tax probably levied in grains.
hiraṇyāśvaratha (EI 12), name of a mahādāna; same as hemāśvaratha.
hiraṇy-āya (EI 7), tax in cash; cf. hiraṇya-deya, kāś-āya.
hiraṇya-deya (EI 17), tax in cash; cf. hiraṇy-āya, kāś-āya.
